Double Team

No damage: you leave a copy of yourself that lures nearby enemies.

Explosion

A huge explosion around you; it costs a quarter of your remaining HP (it never knocks you out).

Dragon Ascent
화룡점정

You dive from the sky at full speed and sweep away everything in your path.

You charge for a moment and fire a huge beam that warps time.

You vanish and drop onto the enemy with a shadow shockwave.

A dark void leaves everyone it catches stunned for a good while.

You charge wrapped in electricity and run over everything in your way.

Beams of light rain down on many enemies on screen.

Two energy slashes fly at the enemy and come back to you.

After a moment, a beam of light falls on an enemy and explodes with great force.

A ring of ice spreads out from you, hits everyone it reaches and slows them.

A cross-shaped burst of seeds on an enemy.

You spin, hitting everything around you and poisoning it.

A swarm of bugs chases the enemies.

Plasma Fists

Thousand Arrows

A rain of earthen arrows falls on many enemies.

name: Rayo Umbrío
Moongeist Beam

A beam of moonlight that goes through everything it hits.

Spirit Shackle

You charge wrapped in the power of the sun and run over everything in your path.

Sparkling Aria

Singing bubbles fly out in every direction and go through several enemies.
